keyFeatures: Protocol fee collection (0.5% on swaps/stakes/NFT purchases)
Percentage-based minimum fee (0.01% of swap amount) - fixes WBTC dust amount bug
Fee-on-transfer token support (90% threshold, allows up to 10% token fee)
Enhanced event logging with actual amounts
Supports both native token (MON) and ERC20 fees
Balance-based validation (prevents malicious token balance manipulation)

changes: Changed minimum fee from fixed 100 wei to percentage-based (0.01% of swap amount)
Extended terms encoding from 53 bytes to 85 bytes (added swapAmount parameter)
Fixed WBTC dust amount bug (0.00003620 WBTC now works)
Updated all tests to use new 85-byte term format
v1.0.1.reason: Fixed critical bug where small WBTC swaps were rejected due to fixed 100 wei minimum fee. WBTC (8 decimals) generates very small wei amounts for small USD values, causing 0.5% protocol fee to be below fixed minimum. Solution: percentage-based minimum (0.01% of swap) scales with swap value regardless of token decimals.

changes: Nested delegation pattern for fee collection

securityConsiderations: Requires ArgsEqualityCheckEnforcer to prevent front-running attacks
Balance-based validation instead of relying on return values
Treasury must be EOA (enforced in constructor)
Maximum fee sanity check (1000 MON) prevents misconfiguration
Percentage-based minimum prevents dust amount exploits

testCategories: WBTC dust amount edge cases (2 tests)
